name: MicroPython
description: A lean implementation of Python 3 for microcontrollers.
summary: Generative AI coding tools are welcome if contributors read and validate the code and talk to reviewers themselves. Copy-pasting to and from a chatbot during review is unacceptable except for translation, and AI agents may not submit pull requests on their own.

evidence.quote: You're welcome to use "generative AI" coding tools when contributing to MicroPython, however:
You (the human contributor) should always be reading and validating new code before submitting it to us for review.
Please do not allow "AI Agents" to submit Pull Requests to MicroPython by themselves.
Copy-pasting to and from a chatbot is unacceptable, unless you're only using it for translation to and from English.
